prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A whimsical, highly detailed miniature haunted house sits at the center of the scene, surrounded by lush, mossy ground and a winding stone path leading to its warmly lit porch. The house features crooked, shingled roofs, ornate wooden trim, and glowing windows that cast a cozy, inviting light. Carved jack-o'-lanterns of various sizes, each with expressive faces, are scattered around the porch and yard, their orange glow contrasting with the deep greens of the moss and foliage. A gnarled, leaf-laden tree with twisting branches leans protectively over the house, adding a touch of fantasy. In the misty, blue-toned background, the silhouettes of tall trees and flying bats evoke a mysterious, enchanted forest atmosphere. The color palette is rich and autumnal, dominated by warm oranges, deep greens, and cool blues, with soft, diffused lighting that enhances the magical, storybook quality of the scene. The composition is intimate and slightly low-angled, drawing the viewer’s eye toward the inviting glow of the house, while a shallow depth of field keeps the focus on the intricate details of the miniature world. The overall style is cinematic and enchanting, reminiscent of a stop-motion animated film or a meticulously crafted diorama.
